en.t: The full text of the saibara song My Home is as follows:
In my home, green curtains are spread, and the bridal chamber is beautifully prepared.

units.source_text: 亲王早光临，请来作东床。

en.t: Prince, please come soon, and take your place as the bridegroom.

units.source_text: 肴馔何所有？此事费商量。

en.t: What delicacies shall we serve? This will take some careful discussion.

units.source_text: 鲍鱼与蝾螺，还是海胆羹？”

en.t: Shall it be abalone and turban shell, or perhaps sea urchin soup?
